shared_elements: flat vertical wall surface treated as a continuous field
horizontal division of the surface into upper and lower zones
justification: A depicts a specific figural scene: a frieze-like row of standing human figures in profile with pointed headgear, raised hands and fringed garments, flanking a smaller seated/enthroned figure and structures, all carved in low relief along a horizontal register. B shows no identifiable depicted subject at all, only a plain wall articulated by vertical recesses and horizontal courses, so beyond the shared notion of a wall divided into horizontal zones there is nothing iconographic in common.
